summary.headline: Entire theme uses grey placeholder rgb(169,169,169) instead of brand color — up to 78% of Page A text styles fail; worse than a754d887d’s single-token orange failures.
summary.comparisonToA754: a754d887d: brand orange fails in context (~25%). af5f0eba6: theme pipeline appears broken → flat grey; focus ring outer layer 2.92:1 (fails) vs 3.61:1 (passes) on a754.
